第九百八十七章 自己人（第1页）
苏牧出手护住了行将崩溃的超脱者金虹。
盘古看着这一幕发生，却没有阻拦。
只见超脱者金虹身上的伤口渐渐愈合，他也缓缓地睁开了眼睛。
只不过此时他身上的气息已经跌落到了道祖境。
他活了下来，但却失去了超脱的修为。
抽时间一定要好好想想怎么能够将理由编的惟妙惟肖，真假难辨，引人同情。还有张二狗的面容和声音迟早都要被寒百陌看到，想要隐瞒根本是不可能的事情，如果那时候他真的怀疑了该怎么办？
等到今天，他们终于动手了，刘显嘉立马通知了关之诺来救人，而且同时他也报了警，这才赶来了一批警察。
安迪选择了报警。可是她需要上班，谭宗明说有要紧事相商，她不等警察调查出结果，就匆匆告辞。
受到了涂德明的嘲讽，孙一凡和张无衣已经不是原来那个任人欺负的初中生。
我：这样吧，你也别问我说的是不是真的，你直接去问谢右喜不喜欢我吧，反正他一向都很直白，喜不喜欢也不会说谎，这样省得你再猜来猜去。
吹牛就要夸大？那也不知道吹的都没有边际了吧？现在想想都觉得替她脸红。也怪不得王爷后来脸色一直都不太好，阴沉沉的。
我那个时候脑海内只有林海鑫的一句话，他说，喜欢林容深会是一件很辛苦的事情，果不其然，辛苦成这样，让如此喜欢他的我，可以心死成这幅模样。
这句话的意思，翻译过来很简单，萧家投资区建设望乡岛，临港市什么都不管，但是给萧家五十年的使用期限。等到五十年后，萧家捞够了钱，岛屿再归还给临港市。
邱莹莹当然不敢将应爸爸误将关雎尔错认为她的事儿告诉爸爸，她觉得爸爸不知道此事，心里反而更有底气。
林容深坐在车内望着我摇摇晃晃的身体没有说话，一直等我到达院子内，他的车才从马路上开走。
宫帱转首直直瞪着那战战兢兢的下人，眼神虽然仍自躁怒，却也未曾继续责骂。
“那你说，这股筑基境二重的灵力气息不是他还能有谁？”端木青天笑道。

江峰已经经历过两次穿越时空的事，早有准备，努力保持着意识清醒，眼看黑洞再次张开，一个翻越拉着柴靖琪跳出，降落在地面，黑洞随之消失。
一时间，十把金剑从各个方向，围着他们攻击起来。但是随着天玄子功力的消耗，那剑招的威力已然没有了与南离军交手时的威力。
“砰”，龙飞的出场方式依旧如此特别，可惜A班的学生早已见怪不怪，自动无视了龙飞的举动。
期间，顾曼婷曾无数次想要把苏凌给甩掉，但苏凌就像是一张狗皮膏药，一直紧紧跟着她，让她无可奈何。
毕竟在乌蒙山脉中灵物众多，而苍鹰可以随便去捕捉这些灵物，让它不停地壮大身上的气息，可是距离苍鹰突破六阶了，估计却还需要一段很长的时间了。
即便到时候有修道者联盟协会的执法组和调查组过来，苏凌也能坦然以待。
“唉！”接引道人轻叹一声，六根清净竹朝着西方八宝灵山而出。
“老大，老大！我发现宝贝啦？”这待在G系机体的阿丽塔雅在跑回到了喵哥时，就很兴奋的说道着。

Pangu watched this scene happen but did not stop it.

It's just that at this time, the aura on his body has fallen to the Dao Ancestor realm.
He survived, but lost his transcendent cultivation.

And Zhang Ergou's face and voice will be seen by Han Baimo sooner or later. It is impossible to hide it. What if he really suspects it at that time?
Today, they finally took action. Liu Xianjia immediately notified Guan Zhinuo to come to the rescue. At the same time, he also called the police, and then a group of police officers arrived.
Andy chose to call the police. But she needed to go to work. Tan Zongming said that they had something urgent to discuss, so she left in a hurry without waiting for the results of the police investigation.
After being ridiculed by Tu Deming, Sun Yifan and Zhang Wuyi were no longer the junior high school students they used to be.
Me: Well, don’t ask me if what I said is true. Just ask Xie You directly if he likes me. Anyway, he has always been very straightforward and won’t lie whether he likes me or not. This saves you the trouble of second guessing.
Is it necessary to exaggerate when bragging? Then you don’t know that there is no limit to your boasting, right? Thinking about it now makes me blush for her. No wonder the prince's face never looked good and gloomy later on.
At that time, I only had a sentence from Lin Haixin in my mind. He said that liking Lin Rongshen would be a very hard thing. Sure enough, it was so hard that I, who liked him so much, could be so heartbroken.
The meaning of this sentence is very simple when translated. The Xiao family investment zone is building Wangxiang Island. Lingang City will not care about anything, but will give the Xiao family a fifty-year period of use. Fifty years later, when the Xiao family has made enough money, the island will be returned to Lingang City.
Of course, Qiu Yingying didn't dare to tell her father that Ying's father had mistaken Guan Ju'er for her. She felt that her father didn't know about it, which made her feel more confident.
Lin Rongshen sat in the car and looked at my swaying body without saying a word. He waited until I arrived in the yard before his car drove away from the road.
Gong Gui turned around and stared directly at the trembling servant. Although his eyes were still angry, he did not continue to scold him.
"Then tell me, who else could have this spiritual aura of the second level of the Foundation Establishment Realm?" Duanmu Qingtian said with a smile.

Suddenly, ten golden swords surrounded them and attacked them from all directions. However, as Tian Xuanzi's skill was consumed, the power of the sword move no longer had the power it had when fighting the Nanli Army.
"Bang", Long Fei's appearance was still so special. Unfortunately, the students in Class A had already become accustomed to it and automatically ignored Long Fei's actions.
During this period, Gu Manting tried to get rid of Su Ling countless times, but Su Ling was like a dog-skin plaster, following her closely, leaving her helpless.
After all, there are many spiritual objects in the Wumeng Mountains, and Goshawk can capture these spiritual objects at will and let them continue to strengthen their aura. However, it will probably take a long time before Goshawk breaks through the sixth level.
Even if the law enforcement team and investigation team of the Monk Alliance Association come over, Su Ling can calmly wait for it.
